lifts.said: The New order screen at /new now has the item (Masala chai), the cups (one, two or three, two to start with), and the New order amount (₹30.00 at the start). It also has a Take the order button, which doesn't save anything yet.
The Today's total screen at /total, for staff, now shows Today's takings (₹113.00 on the sample day) and GST on today's takings (₹5.65, which is five percent rounded to the paisa).
